Risk Mitigation & Pre-Launch Validation Roadmap

LAUNCH GATE • 10/10 MODELS VERIFIED
RISK 01 Policy Changes & Inaccuracy DEFENSE PROTOCOL

Use official manufacturer sources, display a visible "Last Checked" date on every model card, provide direct source links, and strictly separate Confirmed Commitments from Estimates.

RISK 02 Competitor Overlap DEFENSE PROTOCOL

Exclusive focus on model-level software lifespan and update eligibility—not another generic hardware spec sheet, camera ranking, or price tracker.

STEP 01 • VERIFY

Verify All 10 Models

Check official OEM policies for all 10 audited models across the 5 brands.

STEP 02 • AUDIT

Map Competitor Gaps

Compare existing phone-comparison services to document missing lifespan fields.

STEP 03 • TEST

Validate Buyer Demand

Test whether target buyers value dedicated longevity data before full build spend.
